what: Moving the cursor horizontally switches straight to the channel whose slot number it is in, with no in-between values, each time it crosses a slot of screen (or element) width divided by channel count — pick a video or scene by mouse position alone, like flipping TV channels. On narrow screens (width 750 or less) it advances to the next channel every 4 seconds, and swiping left or right (threshold 10px) or tapping the left or right half steps back or forward. Each change fires fx:channel { index, count } Send it and attach data-channel

options.count: Channel count — [data-fx-part=channel] when there are no children (the side drawn on canvas). With children, the number of children
options.area: Width to divide into cells — screen width (default, original) · self (element width)
options.mobile: Width in px that switches between auto-advance and finger swipe, default 750
options.every: Narrow-screen auto-advance interval (seconds), default 4 — 0 turns it off
options.wait: If true, accepts cursor·auto-advance from when fx:channel-on is sent to the element (after it passes the entrance gate)
options.[data-fx-part=channel]: (If present) channel plates — only the one turned on shows as is-on, the rest are display: none
